free_design.Place: a quiet modern indoor saltwater leisure pool, pale turquoise water and sunlit glass walls
free_design.Activity: she tries a floating water xylophone with two small padded mallets; ripples lift the light scalloped swim overskirt away from her upper thighs while the fitted swimsuit remains securely covering
free_design.Pose: standing in shallow water with her torso facing front; both upper arms fall from their own shoulders, elbows beside her waist, each hand holds one mallet forward over the floating instrument; her legs are naturally beneath the water without specified foot placement
free_design.Framing: three-quarter front portrait from her head to upper thighs at chest-height camera, water surface and both hands visible, face directed toward the viewer
free_design.Outfit: a fully lined cobalt swim set with a secure plunging petal-seamed bust panel, small cap-sleeve shoulder straps, fitted high-waisted shorts and a short scalloped swim overskirt attached at the waist; the buoyant skirt flares on the ripples exposing her covered shorts and upper thigh line, intimate areas remain opaque and covered
